text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My rivals— they just keep going, on and on 
without end!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I lost, but still! Craft...! Watching you 
run moved me so much...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
We're looking forward to your mile races 
from now on, too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I won the race. And yet—I lost, Craft.

The sight of Rine Kraft running with 
single-minded devotion, enveloped in 
cheers, became a major topic of 
conversation, especially among the Tiara 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Switching to miles in the end was totally 
the right call for Rhein Kraft, wasn't 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Going from the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile 
Cup... I actually think that's a pretty 
solid route!

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Right... What should I do? Maybe I should 
try talking to my Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(............ The path where you "shine 
the brightest"... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... It was magnificent. So much so 
that my heart is still trembling.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...No, let's stop overthinking. First and 
foremost, the Oaks! I must devote all my 
focus to that.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, congratulations, Kraft. May 
happiness follow wherever your path 
leads."
And so, the NHK Mile Cup came to a close.
